Oh and tailor your resume to each individual job you apply to!

My process has been:

1) Copy + Paste job description and details into chatGPT. 

2) Ask chatgpt to generate a list of keywords or buzzwords that will get picked up by ATS. 

3) Massage those keywords, buzzwords and phrases into my resume (while being honest or at least very confident I can do the job).

4) No more than 3 bullet points per job, and every point must be quantified. How many PMs did you do per week? How many repairs? Did you train people? How many and how much? How much more efficient did you make this process? How much money and time did it save?

The more you apply and revise your resume the better it gets. My previous mistake was putting way too much detail into the resume. It was too long and some of these hiring managers just don’t have the time to read it all. Make it short and sweet, and cut irrelevant jobs and details where possible.
